name: app-quack-command-center
description: Quack Command Center: a local-first, single-owner web dashboard for coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean && rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:repo && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run scan:source && npm run scan:secrets && npm run scan:secrets:history
